editorial:
Imagine landing in a new country with nothing but a smile and some crazy good luck. That is exactly what happens to John Lawless, a charming Irish guy who finds himself working as a butler for Biddle, a millionaire who is anything but normal. You will love the vibe of this movie because it feels like a warm hug. Biddle is a wild card who keeps alligators as pets and teaches boxing during Bible study, which makes him a nightmare for any man trying to date his daughter, Cordelia. It is a funny, lighthearted story about how a little bit of kindness and a lot of luck can shake up a wealthy household.

What really makes this one work is the chemistry between the cast and the upbeat music. The pacing is steady and easy to follow, making it a great pick for a lazy Sunday afternoon. While it is a bit old-school and might feel a little slow for some, the humor holds up well. You should definitely check it out if you enjoy feel-good stories.
endingExplained: Everything wraps up when John proves he is not intimidated by Biddle's wild personality. Unlike other suitors, John genuinely likes the millionaire's quirks. Biddle eventually realizes that John is the perfect match for Cordelia because he brings balance and happiness to their home. After some funny mishaps and romantic tension, Biddle gives his blessing. The movie ends with John and Cordelia getting married, proving that luck and a good heart win the day.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old-fashioned romances and light comedies.
